title: Nonnegativity of folded coordinates
statement: For every integer $z$, the folded coordinate $\varphi(z)$, defined by $\varphi(z)=z$ when $z\ge 0$ and $\varphi(z)=-z-1$ otherwise, is nonnegative.
replaced:
For every integer $z$, the folded coordinate --- equal to $z$ when $z \ge 0$ and to
$-z-1$ otherwise --- is nonnegative.
